applicabilityBasis.summary: YUSD is marketed as a 1:1 USD digital dollar and is integrated with wallets, exchanges, and card infrastructure, but it is BTC-backed, yield-bearing, and rewards holders through a delta-neutral funding strategy. Whether that synthetic yield product is a GENIUS payment stablecoin remains unresolved. The reviewed public materials do not establish a token-specific legal issuer obligation to redeem YUSD for a fixed amount of monetary value, as required by Section 2(22).

genius.notes: Aegis describes YUSD as a BTC-backed, delta-neutral, yield-bearing dollar product. Public mint access requires KYC and onboarding and accepts USDT, USDC and DAI. The opened current product and mint pages do not establish an issuer obligation to redeem YUSD for fixed monetary value. The working Accountable endpoint discloses collateral, liabilities and cryptographically signed reserve snapshots; those snapshots do not establish a monthly independent reserve attestation. Redemption-policy and monthly-attestation booleans are omitted because a complete current disclosure review could not be established while issuer documentation and legal pages were blocked. Archived service terms last updated December 10, 2024 identify Aegis Vault Ltd. in the British Virgin Islands and distinguish Aegis DAO Foundation in the Cayman Islands; these generic historical terms do not establish current token-specific attribution, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile remain omitted. No public token-specific GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification or foreign registration was found in the dated, bounded sources checked. The enforcement enum is omitted because unresolved current legal issuer identity limits an entity-wide negative conclusion. The DASP value concerns GENIUS timing, not issuer access restrictions or other applicable law.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public Aegis/YUSD PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS application or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was located as of October 7, 2026 in the bounded regulator records and searches above. The OCC pending charter table and NYDFS licensing list do not constitute complete GENIUS authorization registers; their negative results are limited to those publications. Archived generic terms identify a BVI company, but current token-specific issuer attribution and a fixed monetary redemption obligation remain unresolved. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was found in the reviewed records or targeted searches. These negative findings do not establish illegality, a legal exemption, or absence from every possible regulatory record.
